{{Short description|Statistics for a sailing competition}}

{{main|SailGP}}

This article gives the summarized standings of each season of '''SailGP''', an international [[sailing (sport)|sailing]] competition that features high-performance [[F50 (catamaran)|F50]] [[Sailing hydrofoil|foiling]] [[catamaran]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sailing-sailgp-launch-idUSKCN1MD2H9|title=Ellison and Coutts launch league for 'supercharged' cats|date=3 October 2018|website=Reuters|access-date=22 September 2019|archive-date=4 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210104102714/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sailing-sailgp-launch-idUSKCN1MD2H9|url-status=live}}</ref>
